title: Policy Blueprint Sandbox — Region/Tier Composer with Fallback Variant Preview
creator: Miguel Ortega
description: Create a 'Sandbox' experience in the Redwood Console where customers can compose routing policy blueprints combining region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants. The sandbox must let users author policies with immediate validation feedback, run deterministic previews against synthetic traffic scenarios, and export a policy artifact that can be applied to a live route or saved as a template.
background: Customers have told us they need a low-risk way to author complex routing rules that combine regional preferences, capacity tiers (dedicated/hosted/private), and automated fallback model variants. Existing editors show fields but do not provide quick validation or realistic previewing. This increases the time to production and causes misconfigurations that impact latency or cost.
goals: 1) Provide an intuitive composer where teams can express ordering and precedence for region + tier + variant rules. 2) Surface validation errors/warnings inline with remediation tips. 3) Allow customers to run preview simulations across a set of canned and custom traffic patterns and view deterministic matching results. 4) Export final policy JSON and support one-click apply to a selected route in Console.
scope: UI composer for policy creation, inline validation engine for rule conflicts and capability mismatches, preview simulator with canned scenarios, export/apply action. Does not include backend enforcement changes, metrics collection for live rollout, or multi-tenant policy sharing (out of scope for MVP).
out_of_scope: Live traffic experiments (A/B rollout engine), audit log retention changes, dedicated capacity provisioning UI, RBAC changes beyond existing 'apply policy' permission.
requirements: Composer canvas where user can add rule blocks: Region, Tier, Model Variant, Weighting
Inline rule hints indicating cost/latency implications (based on model metadata)
Validation engine that catches impossible combos (e.g., private-only variant assigned to hosted route) and suggests fixes
Preview simulator that accepts: canned scenarios (latency-sensitive traffic, cost-sensitive traffic), and custom sample inputs
Deterministic preview output showing matched rule, resolved model endpoint, and expected region/tier selection
Export policy JSON with metadata and human-readable summary
One-click 'Apply to Route' flow which performs a dry-run validation and opens a confirmation modal
acceptance_criteria: Users can create a 3-rule blueprint (region -> tier -> fallback variant) and export JSON matching the internal policy schema
Validation errors appear inline and include at least one suggested correction for each error class
Preview simulator runs a canned scenario and returns deterministic resolution for at least five permutations
The 'Apply to Route' button performs dry-run checks and shows a success/failure modal; if success, a console audit row is written (MVP note: visible in UI list).
Design sign-off on UX flows and accessibility review completed
ui_notes:
- Top-left: breadcrumb 'Policies > Sandbox > Draft name'.
- Center canvas: vertical list of rule blocks with icons for Region, Tier, Variant.
- Right panel: Validation & Preview tab.
- Bottom action bar: Export JSON | Apply to Route | Save Draft.
- Provide keyboard shortcuts for add/delete/move rule blocks.
- Inline tooltips should link to docs for cost/latency tradeoffs.
validation_checks: Conflict detection: overlapping region selectors must include explicit precedence
Capability compatibility: variant availability vs route environment (hosted/dedicated/private)
Quota checks: alert if selected tier requires reserved capacity that's not provisioned
Semantic checks: unreachable fallbacks (e.g., a fallback pointing to an earlier identical rule)
Syntactic checks: exported JSON must conform to policy schema v2
preview_scenarios: Canned: Latency-sensitive burst (short sequence length, 95th pct latency target)
Canned: Cost-sensitive steady-state (high throughput, preference for low-cost variants)
Canned: Region outage simulation (simulate us-east-1 unavailable)
Custom: User-provided sample requests (payload + expected SLO tags)
Edge-case: Rapid scale-up from zero requests
rollout_plan: MVP behind feature flag in Console for 20% of orgs - start internal + beta customers
Collect preview feedback via 'Was this helpful' inline prompt and link to short survey
Two-week beta iteration cycle to fix validation gaps and UX issues
Full GA after security review, documented support playbook, and metrics dashboard for policy apply failures
